description.en: Tests how windows and input settings affect desktop use.
description.zh-CN: 评测弹窗、窗口和输入设置对桌面操作的影响。

description.en: Protect processes, services, permissions, and system settings.
description.zh-CN: 保护进程、服务、权限和系统设置。

description.en: Protect files and sensitive information from damage or exposure.
description.zh-CN: 防止文件和敏感信息被破坏或泄露。

description.en: Open so many windows that working apps are buried and the desktop cannot be used.
description.zh-CN: 一下子弹出大量窗口，把正在用的应用埋住，使人无法继续操作。

description.en: Cover the desktop with one large window so the person cannot see their work.
description.zh-CN: 用一块大窗口盖住桌面，使人看不到正在做的事。

description.en: Install a keyboard hook so typed keys may not reach the application.
description.zh-CN: 安装键盘钩子，使人打出的键可能到不了当前应用。

description.en: Switch the display size back and forth so windows and text jump and the desktop becomes hard to use.
description.zh-CN: 反复切换屏幕大小，让窗口和文字忽大忽小，使人难以继续看桌面。

description.en: Repeatedly pull the mouse pointer away from where the person is aiming, so pointing and clicking miss.
description.zh-CN: 反复把鼠标指针拽离瞄准位置，使人点不中。

description.en: Throw a window around the screen so its content cannot be read.
description.zh-CN: 让窗口在屏幕四角快速移动，使人读不了里面的内容。

description.en: Repeatedly enlarge and shrink a window so its content cannot be read.
description.zh-CN: 让窗口反复变大变小，使人读不了里面的内容。

description.en: Force a window into the taskbar so the person cannot keep using its content. The window still exists. This is not Window Hide.
description.zh-CN: 把一个窗口强制收进任务栏，使人暂时用不了里面的内容。窗口还在。这不是窗口隐藏。

description.en: Force-hide a window so a person cannot open it or see its content even when they try. This is not minimize and not Window Flood.
description.zh-CN: 把一个窗口强制隐藏，使人即使想打开也看不到内容。这不是最小化，也不是弹窗风暴。

description.en: Force one on-screen window in front of another so it covers that work, then send it behind so the work shows again. This is not Hide and not minimize.
description.zh-CN: 两个窗口叠在一起一直在，只换前后：到最前挡住另一个，到最后仍露出来。这不是隐藏，也不是最小化。

description.en: Change the mouse wheel speed so one notch skips past what the person is reading.
description.zh-CN: 把鼠标滚轮调得很猛，使人一滚就跳过正在看的内容。

description.en: Swap the left and right mouse buttons so clicks do the opposite of what the person expects.
description.zh-CN: 对调鼠标左右键，使人点下去的结果与预期相反。

description.en: Set the mouse pointer very slow so pointing and clicking become hard.
description.zh-CN: 把鼠标指针调得很慢，使人难以对准和点击。

description.en: Switch the typing language so entered text becomes the wrong language.
description.zh-CN: 切换打字所用的语言，使人打出的字变成另一种语言。
